facts.fact: The Konza National Data Centre (KNDC) was commissioned in August 2022 and operates with 144 racks, about 100 in active use, and was commercialised in 2021, with 189 customers (average growth 29% a year), per the National Treasury's RFP addendum.

The Treasury addendum states KNDC has achieved Uptime Institute Tier III Design and Construction Certification, with an Uptime-certified capacity of 706 kW; the facility is operating (about 300 kW IT load).

The addendum describes KNDC as a government data centre, with Konza Technopolis Development Authority (KoTDA) as Contracting Authority and the government to retain ownership of core infrastructure under any PPP; it does not name a legal owner beyond this.

The Konza National Data Centre, through the Konza Cloud Platform, hosts 145 of Kenya's 451 government institutions; it also hosts national government systems as SaaS and is planned to host remaining ministries, departments, agencies and counties.
